source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The new C++ documentation tree is connected through the configuration, development index and local toctree. Its reference page offers links and compares Result/Maybe with Rust Result/Option. Those analogies do not establish cross-language ABI mappings. The reviewer proposes an extra XPCOM caveat, but the author declines it in favor of the existing XPIDL link. The hash-container preference is tentative, not a universal rule. Required Bug comment 14 remains unavailable; this source-supported observation carries no full-audit credit.
title: The C++ reference page links analogies rather than defining XPCOM mappings
